title: Rewire or retarget tutored_wipe_wrong_id_test.dart — its D18 fix symbols (resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe, wipeRevokedMirrors) have zero production callers

evidence.quote: // accounts.id rather than a stale id derived from currentAccountIdProvider,

why: This file's entire premise is regression-testing the D18 fix: resolve the mirror-wipe owner id from accounts.id, not from currentAccountIdProvider (which it says returns the talmid's learner_profiles.id during an active tutored session). But grep across lib/ shows the fix helper `resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe` (tutored_pull_providers.dart:187) has no call site anywhere outside its own declaration, and `TutoredMirrorWipeService.wipeRevokedMirrors` has no caller outside this test file. The actual D18 incoming-grants reconcile path (manage_tutors_providers.dart:97-131, `incomingTutorGrantsProvider`) does its own inline reconciliation: it resolves the mirror-lookup scope via `ref.watch(currentAccountIdProvider)` directly — the exact provider this test's own docstring names as unsafe — then wipes stale mirrors one-by-one through a third method, `wipeMirrorForGrant`, that this test never touches either. All four tests in this file pass, but they protect a code path nothing in production calls; the code path that actually runs on grant revocation is completely unguarded against the bug class this file describes. If `currentAccountIdProvider` really does misresolve while `incomingTutorGrantsProvider` evaluates, a revoked tutor keeps local mirrored access to the child's already-revoked data — a child-privacy-adjacent silent-wipe failure this suite cannot catch.
recommendation: Either wire resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe + wipeRevokedMirrors into manage_tutors_providers.dart's incomingTutorGrantsProvider (replacing the inline currentAccountIdProvider-scoped loop) and re-point this test's asserts at that call site, or delete resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe/wipeRevokedMirrors as dead code and rewrite this test against incomingTutorGrantsProvider with a fake AuthState whose currentUser.profileId is a tutored-mirror id, proving the reconcile scope still lands on the tutor's accounts.id.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe(' lib/ (excluding the declaration line) returns at least one call site, OR resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe and wipeRevokedMirrors are removed and this test is rewritten against the code that actually runs.

A test drives manage_tutors_providers.dart's incoming-grants reconcile logic with an AuthState/currentAccountIdProvider resolving to a tutored-mirror profile id and asserts the mirror-wipe scope still resolves to the tutor's accounts.id.

corrections: Severity should be P2, not P1: the "currentAccountIdProvider misresolves to a mirror's learner_profiles.id" premise (from tutored_pull_providers.dart:170-179 / tutored_mirror_wipe_service.dart:27-30 doc comments) is contradicted by AuthState's actual mutation sites (auth_state_provider.dart) and by profile_providers.dart:12-25's own current doc comment, all of which show currentAccountIdProvider always resolves accounts.id in the current per-account-DB architecture — tutored-session identity switching runs through activeProfileIdProvider instead. The dead-code/orphaned-test claim itself (recommendation and acceptance criteria) remains valid and actionable as filed.
